title: Tool selection under context budgets
summary: We compare full tool exposure with progressive disclosure on a synthetic catalog of 25 tools. Top-k retrieval reduces definition tokens while preserving most of the selection accuracy; ambiguous queries remain the main failure mode.

title: Secure tool calling for LLM agents
summary: A threat model for tool-using agents covering tool poisoning, shadowing and SSRF. The authors recommend namespacing, hash pinning and human approval for destructive actions.

title: Retrieval-augmented generation for technical documentation
summary: A case study on technical documentation shows that chunking and citation quality matter more than model size. Recall at k and answer groundedness are reported separately.

title: Evaluating MCP gateways
summary: The paper proposes deterministic task predicates for MCP gateways and reports selection accuracy, argument validity, context cost and gateway latency. LLM judges are excluded to keep runs reproducible.
